newsitem.title: FRANCE: France eyes 257 bln Ffr 98 budget deficit - Robien.
newsitem.headline: France eyes 257 bln Ffr 98 budget deficit - Robien.

text.p: The forecast for France's 1998 budget deficit is 257 billion francs, Gilles de Robien, of the UDF governing coalition party, said on Tuesday.
"We know the main workings of the budget," De Robien, head of the UDF party grouping in the lower house of parliament, said at a regular weekly news briefing.
"It's a deficit of less than three percent (of GDP). We know the constraints. There will be less revenues than in 1997. In 1998 we will not have privatisation revenues, for example," he said.
"It's going to take an effort and some imaginative work to reach a deficit of 257 billion francs after 285 billion for 1997," he said.
The National Assembly, the parliament's lower house, is due to debate 1998 budget needs in May.
